## Details

<a id="draw_fighter"></a>
### [`draw_fighter`](../../../../src/fighter/draw.asm#L6) `$8B59`

*routine*

Draws the pose buffer of fighter $99 into the work bitmap at its column $71,x. Pixel pairs %00 are transparent. After a beaten fighter ($af bit 7), it uses the clipped version that draws only columns below 40.

- **Called from:** [`animate_fighter`](animate.md#animate_fighter)
- **Reads:** [`bout_loser`](../../memory-map.md#bout_loser), [`anim_fighter`](../../memory-map.md#anim_fighter), [`fighter_x`](../../memory-map.md#fighter_x), [`times8_table`](../screen/address_tables.md#times8_table), [`times8_table_hi`](../screen/address_tables.md#times8_table_hi), [`draw_row`](../../memory-map.md#draw_row), [`draw_base`](../../memory-map.md#draw_base), [`work_row_offsets`](../sprites/part_layout.md#work_row_offsets), [`buffer_ptr`](../../memory-map.md#buffer_ptr), [`mask_table`](../../memory-map.md#mask_table), [`buffer_column_offsets`](../sprites/part_layout.md#buffer_column_offsets), [`bitmap_ptr`](../../memory-map.md#bitmap_ptr) and 3 more
